metrics.profile_summary: Senior BI professional with over 9 years of experience in data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical reporting. Expert in Power BI and SQL Server, with a strong track record of delivering business intelligence solutions in the telecom and industrial sectors.

experience.description: Developed Power BI dashboards and implemented RLS using Oracle Database; managed ETL processes and automated report refresh schedules.

experience.role: Assistant Manager – Key Accounts & Net Metering Department
experience.description: Created BI reports from SAP HANA, developed KPI scorecards, and applied Star Schema modeling for customer recovery and billing analysis.

experience.role: Power BI Developer & Data Analyst – PMO Department
experience.description: Built outage monitoring dashboards using SQL Server and Power BI to track telecom infrastructure performance.
Implemented ETL pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, and Azure SQL for large-scale data warehouse solutions.

strengths: Expertise in SQL and database management
Strong data engineering and ETL background
Extensive experience with enterprise-level BI tools
weaknesses: No experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, or React
No evidence of Git or CI/CD pipeline usage
Background is in Data Analytics, not Full Stack Software Engineering
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled Data Analyst and BI Developer, but they lack the essential full-stack development skills (React, Node.js, TypeScript) required for this Software Engineer role.
